title: Kitchen Light
instruments: acoustic guitar, brushed snare, upright bass
lyrics:
[verse]
You left the kitchen light on again
I have stopped turning it off
[chorus]
It is the smallest kind of welcome
The smallest kind of home
You left the kitchen light on
So I would not come back alone
note: Written SPARSE on purpose. Sung recall measured 92% on gospel (organ, claps, space) against 0% on arena rock (walls of distorted guitar in the voice's own range), and thinning neon_saturday took it from 5% to 68%. Few instruments, room around the voice, vocal named once.
